notes.title: Her Love, Like Poison has been released!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! I'm just making a quick post to let you know that my spooky yuri visual novel, [i]Her Love, Like Poison[/i], has been released!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/468de97559b15a5487765facaaccdfa38150a8b6.png[/img]

If you've read any of my other yuri VNs, then [i]Her Love, Like Poison[/i] might look familiar. The character art is by the same artist of my previously released yandere yuri visual novel, [i]It gets so lonely here[/i], and the UI is in a similar style.

I wrote [i]Her Love, Like Poison[/i] pretty soon after finishing up [i]Lonely[/i] (I must have been in the mood for more toxic yuri set in the woods), so while the two stories are unrelated, they might be a little bit similar tone-wise.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/46466091d3d03b8df4af805527fbf3963269452b.png[/img]

In any case, I hope you enjoy the story if you do check it out! It's quite a short game, so it's priced accordingly (it's $6.99 with a 10% launch discount).

You can pick it up here if you're interested:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3412620/

As always, thank you for your support over the years! It's very much appreciated!

- ebi x

notes.title: Cute BxG VN Maid For My Master has been released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I'm writing a quick announcement to let you know that[i] Maid For My Master[/i] has been released!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/7131364d4479d6e0a44290a2203403e78c640c1a.png[/img]

[i]Maid For My Master[/i] is a cute romance visual novel about a young man who falls in love with a robot maid. The story is very light-hearted, and it was partially inspired by [i]Chobits.[/i]

The story contains a little bit of drama, but it does have a happy ending, and it doesn't contain any especially upsetting content. I think this would be a good story to read if you want something sweet and hopeful to cheer you up!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/f1ac87c6cd5f090f8e9e57e7cbade1befa261849.png[/img]

There is an adult patch for the game available on Steam, but it isn't necessary to enjoy the story. Feel free to download the patch or not; it's up to you.

You can find the VN here if you want to read it:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364490

As always, thank you for supporting me while I release so many projects. I hope you enjoy [i]Maid For My Master[/i] if you do choose to check it out, and you have a good time with Holly!
